user.title: Choose how the inverter is connected

serial.title: Serial port (USB adapter or ESPHome serial proxy)
serial.description: Pick a local RS485 USB adapter or an ESPHome device exposing the inverter through the serial_proxy component. ESPHome proxies only show up once the ESPHome device is set up in Home Assistant.

error.esphome_not_ready: The ESPHome device is not connected yet. Wait for it to come online and try again.
